Prices

Questions

How much do projects in Telegram bots and mini apps cost?
At Qilich an MVP in this group costs $1,000–10,000 (UZS 12–121 mln), a full version up to $32,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does a project in Telegram bots and mini apps take?
Qilich builds an MVP in 1–7 weeks and a full version in 4–16 weeks.
What do we need to provide for a project in Telegram bots and mini apps?
A company Telegram account for the bot, the list of products or services with prices, a person who takes the orders.
